title: Bare-name phase 2: the namespace-prefix lint warns on every bare non-object name; first-party templates and examples adopt the prefix (ruling C on #30798)
body:
epic:#3600#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPXwX1YfHyKJUh4agu

Filing-gate category: ② execution of a maintainer ruling. Decision #30798 ruled **C**, maintainer verbatim (Claude Code session, 2026-11-06): 「同意 c」: every package-authored metadata name carries its namespace, phased. Routing, verbatim: 「能交给车队开发的你不要自己开发」.

Phase 2 of 3 (lint, templates, examples). It can run in parallel with phase 1.

## Problem

The existing `naming/namespace-prefix` rule (`packages/cli/src/commands/lint.ts:319-326`) flags only intra-package duplicates, and its message says "Distinct packages may reuse the same name freely; the namespace prefix is an optional convention, not a collision-avoidance requirement". That is now the opposite of the ruled contract. ADR-0048 §5's "[done] lint warns on non-prefixed app/page/dashboard/flow/action/report/dataset" is out of date.

## Ask

1. Re-widen the rule to warn on every bare package-authored top-level name: every type except names derived from a prefixed object (fields, object extensions, container views `<object>.<key>`) and names already namespaced (translations `<ns>_<locale>`). Rewrite the message to state the contract and the rename.
2. Correct ADR-0048 §5's lint bullet in the same PR.
3. Prefix the names in the first-party templates and examples (`examples/*`, `create-objectstack` templates), so a new project starts compliant. Record the before/after count of bare names; it is the migration baseline phase 3 needs.

Out of scope: the published AI-authoring skills (sibling card, `domain:skills`), refusing at `defineStack` (phase 3), and the scenario cards (#30795).

Reader: the `domain:devx` lane seat, from `pm:queue`.
